title: Energy Flow and Pyramids
summary: Only about 10% of energy passes from one level to the next. Why food chains are short and top predators are rare.

ib.note: Productivity and efficiency calculations follow in MYP 5 / DP ESS

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 12: How Nature Works in Harmony

objectives: I can explain how energy flows through a food chain.
I can use the 10% rule to calculate energy at each level.
I can explain why there are fewer organisms at higher levels.
misconceptions: Top predators get most of the energy.
All the food an animal eats becomes its body.
